data.narrative:
Lohum Cleantech is a Series C-stage climate and energy company founded by Rajat Verma that has raised $87.7M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (Linamar, LNZA), with primary focus on 3 same-stage, same-sector private companies: KoBold Metals ($3.0B), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B), and Amogy ($700M).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy base of $88M and applying a typical 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $149M. Peer-median analysis across the 3-company comp set yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in business model maturity and capital intensity within the frontier climate-tech sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $127M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $575M. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects the early-stage capital intensity of the target relative to later-stage peers in the sample. Key uncertainties include the comparability of peer technology platforms, path to unit economics, and the timing and scale of commercialization. Resolution of these factors will be critical in determining whether Lohum trends toward the lower or upper end of the implied range.
